proposed_facts.reason: Canonical collision branches confirm the inputs and priority; the fallback helper explicitly assigns GA_Air.
The ground-origin wrapper delegates to aerial collision, whose impact, airborne-reset and gated cliff branches match this purpose.
Landing writes gr_vel before calling common conversion, which assigns gr_vel from self_vel.x; motion selection precedes accessory callback installation.

Entry reset order, command latch, numeric x114 comparison, collision alternatives and paired callback calls are supported. The shared velocity helper directly reads animation translation offsets. Allocation success and article lifetime are appropriately not asserted.

Canonical source confirms airborne ground-origin setup, post-initialization resets, frame-20 transition, aerial latch and literal GA_Ground return comparison. The ending dispatcher has early exceptional branches before ordinary Wait.
Landing delegates to the helper that multiplies friction only above absolute walk-speed threshold and then applies friction and movement. Its multiplier magnitude is not established.

contradictions.reason: Accept deferral of all five .sdata2 facts and both section links: source literal expressions establish uses, not emitted storage, section attribution, pool size or ordering. No compiled conclusion is warranted.
The reversed grounding interpretations in the collision data-flow and purpose facts are corrected: the alternate successful-contact branch calls a helper that explicitly sets GA_Air.

The collision state-behavior correction preserves ordered cross-file writes: initial zero ground velocity is not a final-speed guarantee because grounded conversion subsequently assigns self_vel.x to gr_vel.

The file data-flow correction preserves the actual numeric x114 guard and airborne fallback. Accept deferral of x114's value, external command producers, accessory dispatch timing and article lifetime; local code proves two calls and callback self-clearing, not guaranteed creation.

The file state-behavior correction properly places resets after motion selection and animation initialization, preserves exceptional ending branches and retains the literal landing collision return test. Accept deferral of deeper collision-return semantics. Rendered GroundToAir remains a phase-name hypothesis, not proof of physical conversion.
The landing-physics mapping correctly replaces an unsupported stronger-friction assertion with conditional multiplication. Landing setup also does not guarantee final zero ground speed.
